desc:
Welcome to Bank Robbery Simulator!
🎉UPDATE 2:
- New Area (Jungle)

USE CODE "15KLIKES" for 15 mins of 2x SELL and 250 Diamonds!

HOW TO PLAY:
💵 Collect money around the map to fill your bag!

📈 Try to get to the top of the leaderboards!

Join the group HD Games for an in-game reward:
🐲 HD Pet
⚡ Chat Tag
👑 Name Tag 

Made by HD Games

scripts.title: Autofarm
scripts.script:
if game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("ScreenGui") then
game:GetService("CoreGui").ScreenGui:Destroy()
end

local folder = main:AddFolder('Area 1')
local folder2 = main:AddFolder('Area 2')
local folder3 = main:AddFolder('Area 3')

folder:AddToggle({text = "Auto Collect Coins", flag = "autofarm", callback = function(state)
if state then
getgenv().Farming1 = true
		while Farming1 == true do
            if Workspace.Areas["1"].PickupItems:FindFirstChild("Stack of Money") then 
			game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(game:GetService("Workspace").Areas["1"].PickupItems["Stack of Money"].Main.Position)
end         
			wait()
		end
else
getgenv().Farming1 = false
end
end})

main:AddToggle({text = "AutoCollectV2", flag = "autofarm", callback = function(state)
if state then
getgenv().Farming1 = true
		while Farming1 == true do
            if Workspace.Areas["2"]:FindFirstChild("Sell") then 
                function ClosestPart()
                    local dist = math.huge
                    local target = nil
                    for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace").Areas:GetChildren()) do
                        for i1,v1 in pairs(v.PickupItems:GetChildren()) do
                            local magnitude = (v1.Main.Position - game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position).magnitude
                            if magnitude < dist then
                                dist = magnitude
                                target = v1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return target
                end
                firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, ClosestPart().Main, 1)
                firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, ClosestPart().Main, 0)
			wait()
		end
end
else
getgenv().Farming1 = false
end
end})

main:AddToggle({text = "AutoSell[off autocollectv2]", flag = "autofarm", callback = function(state)
if state then
getgenv().Farming1 = true
		while Farming1 == true do
            if Workspace.Areas["2"]:FindFirstChild("Sell") then 
                numbers = {}
                for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace").Areas:GetChildren()) do
                    table.insert(numbers,v.Name)
                end
                firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, game:GetService("Workspace").Areas[math.max(table.unpack(numbers))].Sell, 0)
                firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, game:GetService("Workspace").Areas[math.max(table.unpack(numbers))].Sell, 1)
			wait()
		end
end
else
getgenv().Farming1 = false
end
end})
